critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage passed at all viewports with visible focus for every expected Atlas control and header link; no touch-target violations or uncontained viewport overflow were measured. Reduced-motion sampling found no changed-element trajectories. However, serious color-contrast checks remain unresolved: 10 Atlas nodes on desktop, including all eight React Flow stages and both status badges, plus 12 mobile-header links and one tablet-header link. No manual screen-reader, reflow/zoom, or activation-behavior evidence was supplied, so WCAG readiness is not proven.
critique.fix: Resolve and manually measure contrast for every incomplete node against its composited background, especially stage nodes, badges, and header links. Then add screen-reader testing, 200%/400% zoom reflow checks, and keyboard activation/state-announcement tests for tabs, stage selection, vector selection, the scrollable header, and React Flow alternatives.
